name: RetroSite
description: A love letter to the 90s web: an informational site about 1990s web design and how it has changed, built the way a 1997 homepage was. Uses HTML 3.2, <FONT> tags, table layouts, frames, marquees, hit counters, a guestbook and a webring.

name: RetroStation
description: A self-hosted, MyRetroTVs-style TV station that turns your video library into live, scheduled channels with commercial breaks, a program guide and on-screen graphics, streamed to every TV in the house. Built with ASP.NET Core (.NET 10) and FFmpeg.

name: ADO-Portal
description: A read-only web app for reporting on Azure DevOps work items.

name: Finent
description: Finent is a personal-finance and budgeting web app built around your paycheck, not the calendar month. Instead of a flat monthly summary, it organizes your money around each pay period — telling you exactly what's due before your next payday, how much to set aside, and how much is genuinely free to spend.

name: MetaLens
description: A small full-stack web app: upload any common image format and get its metadata back
